scope: Q364 factual investigation only, no IDE configuration or product change
probe_source:
REQUEST HB_CODEPAGE_UTF8
REQUEST HB_CODEPAGE_UTF8EX
PROCEDURE Main()
 LOCAL cp, cLower := hb_HexToStr('c3a9'), cUpper := hb_HexToStr('c389')
 FOR EACH cp IN {'UTF8','UTF8EX','EN'}
  hb_cdpSelect(cp)
  OutStd(cp+' LowerE='+hb_StrToHex(Upper(cLower))+' UpperE='+hb_StrToHex(Upper(cUpper))+Chr(10))
 NEXT
 RETURN
probe_output:
UTF8 LowerE=C3A9 UpperE=C389
UTF8EX LowerE=C389 UpperE=C389
EN LowerE=C3A9 UpperE=C389
conclusion: UTF8 Upper leaves accented case pair unchanged; UTF8EX differs. IDE experimental host intentionally selects UTF8. No global change made or compatibility assumed. Existing ASCII-insensitive code is not full Unicode casefold.
limitations: Standalone library probe, not terminal/IDE end-to-end evidence or accepted switch proposal
No normalization/grapheme guarantee, Windows or distribution acceptance
